description: Works out the nine VAT return boxes for one quarter from the open DIYA-GL book: the quarter ending on periodEnd, with HMRC's box names and rounding, each month's figures, and the sales and purchases lines behind boxes 1, 4, 6 and 7. Use this when the person asks what their VAT return comes to, for their MTD VAT figures or the quarter's VAT, what the nine boxes are, or why a box has its figure. It refuses a book that is not VAT registered, a quarter the book does not hold, and a quarter whose lines do not agree with the book's VAT figures. It does not file the return or contact HMRC; prepare_vat_return gives the link to file it.

periodEnd.description: The obligation's period end, YYYY-MM-DD; must be a month end the book's VAT interface carries

periodKey.description: The obligation's period key, echoed back for the submit call

periodStart.description: The obligation's period start, YYYY-MM-DD; refused unless it opens the quarter ending periodEnd
